title: Can You Find Something Red?
description:
Apples, strawberries, and fire trucks. What color are they all? Bloop the jelly blob finds out! 🌈
A fun learning Short for kids ages 1–5 from Bloop's Color Lab.

Red! This is my friend Red. An apple is red. A ball can be red. A heart is red, too! Can you find something red around you? Point to it!
